WITH ssr AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.s_store_id, r.s_store_id) AS s_store_id,
        COALESCE(s.sales, 0) AS sales,
        COALESCE(s.profit, 0) AS profit,
        COALESCE(r.returns, 0) AS returns,
        COALESCE(r.profit_loss, 0) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT
            st.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
            SUM(sa.sales) AS sales,
            SUM(sa.profit) AS profit
        FROM (
            SELECT
                ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
                SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
                SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit
            FROM store_sales AS ss
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
            GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk
        ) AS sa
        JOIN store AS st ON sa.store_sk = st.s_store_sk
        GROUP BY st.s_store_id
    ) AS s
    FULL OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT
            st.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
            SUM(ra.returns) AS returns,
            SUM(ra.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
        FROM (
            SELECT
                sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
                SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS returns,
                SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
            FROM store_returns AS sr
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
            GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk
        ) AS ra
        JOIN store AS st ON ra.store_sk = st.s_store_sk
        GROUP BY st.s_store_id
    ) AS r ON s.s_store_id = r.s_store_id
),

wsr AS (

            SUM(sa.sales) AS sales,
            SUM(sa.profit) AS profit
        FROM (
            SELECT
                ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
                SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
                SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit
            FROM web_sales AS ws
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
            GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
        ) AS sa
        JOIN web_site AS site ON sa.web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
        GROUP BY site.web_site_id
    ) AS s
    FULL OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT
            site.web_site_id AS web_site_id,
            SUM(ra.returns) AS returns,
            SUM(ra.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
        FROM (
            SELECT
                ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
                SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS returns,
                SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
            FROM web_returns AS wr
            JOIN date_dim AS dd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
            LEFT JOIN web_sales AS ws ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
                                      AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
            WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
            GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
        ) AS ra
        JOIN web_site AS site ON ra.web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
        GROUP BY site.web_site_id
    ) AS r ON s.web_site_id = r.web_site_id
)
SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM wsr
) AS x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
